conclusion: Reject this frozen implementation after pilot; no confirmation or threshold scan. The single-source complete-tail certificate held in all selected executions but did not yield whole-run gains. This is not evidence of theoretical impossibility or of all complete-tail objectives being ineffective.
limits: Same-case paired runs share a scenario but diverge after the first changed action; later bearings and geometry are not controlled isolated effects.
Parent proxy gaps and conditional per-state UBs are not expected-time savings, and their sum is not a whole-run causal decomposition.
No profiler run; logged envelope wall times identify overhead, not a rigorous nonoverlapping CPU decomposition.
This diagnosis checks actual selected plan execution and existing audit receipts; it is not a new universal geometry proof or independent confirmation sample.
